app.title: Show HN: Carton Clock – A working pendulum clock made from empty drink cartons
app.description: A physical pendulum clock constructed from recycled cardboard cartons, featuring a simple mechanical escapement and hands powered by a small motor.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and compile the Arduino sketch
Upload the firmware to an Arduino board and power the clock
Measure the accuracy of the pendulum over a 60‑minute period
Verify the motor timing and escapement operation via a simple test script
